name: JSON 组件工程化
summary: 组件不再只是 compositions 里引用的隐式 JS 文件。NextFrame 提供机器可读 registry 和 CLI 校验，提前发现缺文件、坏导出、非法 import 和参数覆盖，保证 preview/export 共用同一条组件契约。
rules: component id only uses lowercase letters, numbers, dots, and hyphens
component source is one JS file under project/components/{id}.js
component source must export mount and update functions
component source cannot import other modules
validation output must be structured JSON for AI tools

visual.demo_style: self-playing state transition, 8-12 seconds, progress bar and done toast
visual.product_style: no new editor panel in this version
